how: Candidates were the 3 most-discussed armed issues in runtime dependencies per repo (84). Each was read in full by an independent agent and kept only if open, a bug report, confirmed on the exact version, and in the claimed package: 41 of 84 passed. These are a hand-picked, de-duplicated subset of those.

examples.title: `sympy.discrete.transforms.fft` performs inverse FFT
examples.summary: sympy.discrete.transforms.fft uses the opposite sign in the exponent, so it effectively computes the inverse DFT (e.g. fft([0,1,0,0]) returns [1, I, -1, -I] instead of [1, -I, -1, I]).
examples.evidence: DietBru (reporter): "In [3]: sy.__version__ / Out[3]: '1.14.0'" then "sy.fft(x)  # wrong result"

examples.title: Controlled drawer with `modal={false}` does not work because of bug in `useControllableState`
examples.summary: A controlled Drawer with modal={false} that is opened from outside (via the open prop) leaves pointer-events: none on the body, blocking interaction with the rest of the page.
examples.evidence: bryanakitchen (comment): "I'm experiencing this issue with vaul 1.1.2."

examples.title: Tokens rotation does not persist the new token
examples.summary: When the `jwt` callback refreshes an access token, next-auth does not persist the returned token, so later requests keep using the old, expired one.
examples.evidence: DaviReisVieira: 'I have th same issue at beta.25.' (next-auth v5 beta)

examples.title: Bug: a component loses its state when its type changes from React.lazy to the component the lazy resolved to
examples.summary: When an element's type changes from a React.lazy wrapper to the plain component it resolved to, React remounts it and discards its state (e.g. RSC client components later rendered from plain JSX).
examples.evidence: nitedani (reporter): "Bundle this with react and react-dom 19.3.1 ... It prints `plain -> lazy: 1, lazy -> plain: 0, lazy -> plain in an array: 0`"

examples.title: Turbopack generates external module references with hashes that don't match installed packages when node_modules structure differs
examples.summary: Turbopack production builds reference external modules by hashed aliases (e.g. require-in-the-middle-<hash>) that fail with "Cannot find module" when node_modules is reinstalled or laid out differently at runtime; next build --webpack works.

examples.title: Unhandled 'error' event when using AbortSignal to cancel requests
examples.summary: Aborting a node-fetch request with a body via AbortSignal can crash the process with an unhandled 'error' event, because the request body stream has no error listener when destroyed.
examples.evidence: AleCaste (reporter): '| node-fetch | 3.3.2' with the unhandled 'error' event trace

examples.title: Import issues with ESM and CJS
examples.summary: Recent releases mislabel the CommonJS build as ESM (type: module with a .js CJS file), so tools such as Vitest, Playwright and Sanity fail with "ReferenceError: exports is not defined"; 2.1.8 works.
examples.evidence: samtsai (reporter): "@phosphor-icons/react v2.1.10 ... ⚠️ A require call resolved to an ESM JavaScript file" plus "ReferenceError: exports is not defined" when running vitest; "downgrading to `2.1.8` works."

examples.title: CSS cascade order differs between dev and production when using auto-imported component styles
examples.summary: Production builds can link auto-imported component CSS chunks in a different order than dev (e.g. a component stylesheet before index.css), so the CSS cascade differs between dev and production and the wrong rules win.
examples.evidence: robertsLando (comment): "We retested after updating to Vite `8.0.16`, and the issue is still reproducible with Vuetify/component CSS."

examples.title: outputSchema always emitted as JSON Schema draft-07, breaking clients that only accept 2020-12
examples.summary: McpServer always emits tool `outputSchema` as JSON Schema draft-07 with no way to choose 2020-12, so clients that accept only 2020-12 reject every tool that declares an outputSchema.
examples.evidence: clash-90: 'Still reproducible on SDK 1.32.1 ... Checked against the installed package' (toJsonSchemaCompat returns draft-07 $schema)

examples.title: pytube.exceptions.RegexMatchError: get_throttling_function_name: could not find match for multiple
examples.summary: pytube raises `RegexMatchError: get_throttling_function_name: could not find match for multiple` when fetching streams because its regex no longer matches YouTube's player JS.

examples.title: Header cell collapses when resizable set to true and promoted to staging environment
examples.summary: In production builds, react-data-grid header cells collapse when columns are resizable, sortable or frozen, because the minifier merges its nested `@layer` CSS rules.

examples.title: Duplicate Location and x-nextjs-stale-time in Header using redirect/permanentRedirect alongside dynamic 'force-static'
examples.summary: Next.js emits duplicate `Location` headers for `redirect()`/`permanentRedirect()` on static/ISR routes, which some proxies and clients turn into a broken `/target,/target` redirect.
examples.evidence: f0rr0: 'Additional standalone reproduction on Next.js 16.2.6 and 16.4.0' (2 Location fields on cache MISS)

examples.title: Getting 'sharredString's when trying to parse XSLX in the streaming mode
examples.summary: The streaming XLSX reader sometimes returns { sharedString: n } placeholder objects instead of the actual cell strings.
examples.evidence: gerpedrosa (comment): "This bug is still present in version 4.4.0."

examples.title: [v9] Data update from external source doesn't trigger rerenders in components with table object references
examples.summary: In TanStack Table v9 with React Compiler, replacing `data` from an external source does not re-render components built with `createTableHook`, so they keep showing stale rows.
examples.evidence: davidmateita (reporter): 'TanStack Table version v9.2.4'; Bhavani2016: 'I reproduced this locally with React Compiler enabled on 9.2.4'
